meta.title: CtxKit context library
meta.description: Build a sourced Markdown context library from opted-in work. Choose storage in the plugin panel; your choice is remembered automatically. Browse and recall relevant records. Capture is off by default.

library.title: Context library
library.intro: Work normally. In opted-in sessions, useful outcomes become sourced notes; relevant context can be recalled without mentioning CtxKit.
library.scope: Access checked against the selected session
library.shared: Topics and captured dossiers belong to the shared configured library. Processing status is for this session only.
library.emptyBody: No managed records were found in this section. Useful new work in opted-in sessions can gradually build this library.
library.noMatchesBody: Try fewer keywords or clear the search and filter.
library.noSessionBody: Choose a real session in the sidebar, then open Context library. Its current workspace and permissions determine access; this page creates no session.
library.unconfiguredBody: No library files were read. Choose storage in Plugins → CtxKit. Capture authorization is separate and remains off by default.
library.deniedBody: This session’s workspace or current file permissions do not allow this read. Select an authorized session or ask the administrator to review its access. This page cannot change permissions.
library.errorBody: The host could not complete this bounded read. Refresh the view after checking the connection and plugin availability.
library.timeoutBody: No result was accepted after 15 seconds. Refresh the view when the host is available.
library.unavailableBody: The host did not recognize the library request. Check that both halves of the CtxKit plugin are installed and active.
library.truncated: Bounded results: some content was omitted. Use a narrower search or the next page when available.
library.snapshot: Read-only snapshot. Refresh to see later processing changes.
library.plainText: Safe plain-text Markdown view; embedded HTML and links are not executed.
library.draft: Procedure draft — not installed or authorized to run.
library.statusHelp: Processed means this capture stage finished, not that the project is complete. A saved checkpoint and organized topic are separate stages.
library.storageHelp: On the machine running DSH. Confirm a folder to remember it automatically; changing it pauses capture without moving existing documents.
library.storageChanged: The location changed elsewhere. Reload the current directory before choosing again.
library.storageUnavailable: The storage directory is temporarily unavailable. Reload to try again; technical details are below.
library.storageReadonly: This connection can view the directory but cannot change it.
library.storageDenied: This connection cannot read the storage directory.
library.storageInvalid: Choose an existing absolute directory on the DSH host.
library.storageRejected: The host did not accept this directory. It must exist, must not be a symbolic link, and must be permitted.
library.storageError: The result is unknown; the directory may already have been remembered. Reload the current directory before choosing again.
library.storageBrowseHelp: Open folders to navigate. Confirming “Use this directory” remembers it immediately; Cancel changes nothing.
library.storageNoFolders: No visible child folders in this directory.
library.storageBrowseError: Unable to browse host folders. Try Home or cancel and try again.
library.storagePickerUnavailable: The host directory chooser is unavailable on this connection. Cancel and check the host directory service.
library.storageNativeWaiting: Waiting up to two minutes for the folder chooser on the DSH host. Closing this section cancels the request.
library.storageClientMissing: This page has no native Settings client service. Refresh the page and check the DSH Remote assembly.
library.storageHostFailed: The native Settings API returned a failure. The safe error code below identifies the Host/API problem; no configuration values are included.
library.storageRequestFailed: The Settings request failed before a valid response arrived. Check the connection and reload saved settings.
library.storageResponseInvalid: The native Settings response has an unexpected format. Check that the page and Host use compatible DSH versions.
library.storageDescriptorMissing: Native Settings responded, but did not expose the CtxKit configuration entry. Check that the Host has loaded the updated CtxKit plugin with its Config schema; updating the page alone is not sufficient.
library.storageDescriptorAmbiguous: Native Settings returned duplicate CtxKit configuration entries. No entry was selected; check the Host plugin registration.
library.storageSchemaIncompatible: The CtxKit entry exists, but its root/enabled schema is incompatible with this page. Reload the page after confirming the updated Host plugin is active.
library.storageValueInvalid: The CtxKit entry exists, but its configuration values or revision have an unexpected format. No value was accepted; reload saved settings after checking the Host plugin version.
